caption: Ровная струя из трубы в осеннем овраге.
scene: Close eye-level view of a modest rusty steel spring pipe emerging from a mossy concrete bank. A continuous narrow stream falls into a weathered concrete channel. Damp brown maple leaves, bare birches, late October overcast daylight. The pipe and falling stream occupy the middle of the frame.

caption: Действующий выход воды и каменистое русло.
scene: A low spring outlet between rough stones in a deciduous park ravine, visibly running water feeding a shallow rocky channel, wet yellow leaves, handheld slightly tilted framing from a visitor crouching beside the spring.

caption: Вода стекает по старому бетонному желобу.
scene: View from above of running spring water in an old concrete gutter, a short unpainted metal outlet and fallen alder leaves. Uneven muddy ground and weathered stones, quiet flat autumn light. Clearly visible continuous flow, ordinary unpolished park infrastructure.

caption: Общий вид работающего родника на склоне.
scene: Medium-wide visitor photograph of an unadorned working spring on a wooded slope. Water visibly pours from a low metal pipe into a drainage channel. Bare deciduous trees and wet brown leaf litter, cloudy late autumn afternoon, a modest park path in the background.

caption: Тонкая струйка у края трубы.
scene: Very close smartphone photograph of an old metal spring pipe with only a thin thread of water at the bottom lip, damp concrete immediately beneath, dark wet leaves, low natural light. Show weak flow unmistakably, with no strong stream or splash.

caption: Редкие капли из выхода родника.
scene: Close oblique view of a worn pipe outlet with a few visible drops, a small wet patch in a largely dry channel, moss and brown leaves, ordinary autumn forest ravine. Imperfect focus and slight phone-camera noise.

caption: Слабый поток и узкий ручей ниже выхода.
scene: Low angle showing a very thin spring flow coming from a small pipe into a narrow mostly dry stone runnel. Surrounding concrete is damp only along the center. Fallen ochre leaves, late October park, overcast daylight.

caption: Сухой выход воды, листья под трубой.
scene: Dry empty steel spring pipe in a cracked concrete bank, no stream and no dripping, curled dry brown leaves gathered directly under the outlet and a dry concrete gutter. Close documentary phone photograph, cloudy autumn afternoon.

caption: Пересохший желоб и пустое русло.
scene: A non-flowing spring outlet at the head of an empty stone-lined channel, damp moss on the bank but no open water and no drops from the pipe. Leaves resting undisturbed in the empty channel, bare trees, subdued autumn colors.

caption: Отверстие трубы затянуто льдом.
scene: Tight close view of a small metal spring outlet sealed with opaque ice, short irregular icicles on its rim, a thin layer of frozen water on the gutter, brown leaves with hoarfrost, early cold morning in late autumn, no flowing stream.

caption: Наледь у выхода и на желобе.
scene: Unadorned woodland spring pipe and concrete gutter encased in irregular cloudy ice, patchy light snow on brown forest floor, bare birch trunks, diffused cold daylight. The outlet is visibly frozen, restrained ordinary smartphone documentation.

caption: Свободный спуск к площадке родника.
scene: Phone photograph looking down an unobstructed park footpath and a few rough concrete steps towards a small spring landing. Brown fallen leaves at the edges, clear walkable center, a simple metal handrail, bare deciduous woodland, overcast late October.

caption: Открытая тропа вдоль ручья.
scene: An ordinary narrow but clear pedestrian path along a small ravine stream leading to a low spring outlet. No branches obstruct the path. Damp autumn leaves, exposed roots at the edges, natural overcast daylight, casual standing-height phone photograph.

caption: Проходимый подход к роднику после дождя.
scene: Unobstructed modest spring landing at the end of a short dirt path, wet ground after rain, no deep puddles on the walking line, low pipe and channel in the background. Realistic untidy autumn park, flat natural light.

caption: Тонкий лёд на ступенях перед родником.
scene: Downward visitor view of several concrete steps and the small landing in front of a spring pipe, both covered with a thin translucent layer of ice and a few stuck brown leaves. An unpainted metal handrail along the steps. Cold late-autumn morning, patchy frost rather than deep snow.

caption: Скользкий участок тропы у выхода воды.
scene: A narrow glazed icy section of a park trail immediately beside a low spring pipe and channel. Small patches of snow and brown leaves around the ice, no visitors. Camera tilted down as if a walker is documenting the slippery surface.

caption: Упавшее дерево перекрыло тропу.
scene: A fallen deciduous tree trunk lying across the narrow approach path to an ordinary woodland spring, clearly obstructing the way, many brown leaves, broken twigs, the spring outlet barely visible farther down the path. Unstaged handheld phone view.

caption: Ограждение на подходе к площадке.
scene: A simple temporary metal barrier physically closing the narrow footpath to a spring landing in a wooded ravine. Plain unmarked barrier with no signs or lettering. Damp autumn ground, weathered steps behind the barrier, cloudy afternoon.

caption: Убранная площадка у родника.
scene: A modest concrete spring landing and the beginning of its channel, free from bottles or rubbish, with only natural fallen leaves at the edge. Bare birches and damp soil, ordinary old infrastructure, soft overcast autumn daylight, documentary phone photo rather than scenic tourism.

caption: Берег ручья без бытового мусора.
scene: View down at a short stretch of a shallow spring-fed runnel and the adjacent footpath, ordinary stones and natural leaves but no litter, a small plain pipe at the top edge. Unpolished local park, brown late-autumn palette, handheld framing.

caption: Пакеты и пластик возле тропы.
scene: A few discarded unbranded plastic bottles, an empty plain cup and a crumpled carrier bag in brown leaves just beside the path to a woodland spring. The immediate pipe outlet remains unobstructed in the background. Small believable amount of litter, not an enormous dump, overcast late autumn.

caption: Упаковки у скамейки возле родника.
scene: Low phone photograph of a worn park bench near a small spring landing, with two unbranded discarded wrappers and a plastic bottle underneath. Wet brown leaves, bare trees, modest spring infrastructure in the background, no readable print.

caption: Отколотый край бетонного желоба.
scene: Close documentary phone image of a visibly chipped and cracked concrete spring gutter, a broken side edge letting a little water escape onto the ground, a plain steel outlet nearby. Damp brown leaves and moss, believable weathering, flat cloudy late-autumn light.

caption: Повреждённая ступень на подходе.
scene: A broken concrete step and leaning plain metal handrail immediately before an ordinary spring landing, clearly visible crack and displaced concrete piece, no dramatic destruction. Bare woodland, wet leaf litter, casually framed documentary smartphone photograph.
